title: Council Session 04 (COUNCIL-2026-10-18-04): Three-Model Adversarial Review of the MHCN-2 RWA Evidence Spec — 3-0 AMEND Verdict, Same-Night v0.2 Amendments, and Disclosed Integrity Discrepancies
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic; no customer-identifiable data appears in this record (POL-DISC-001).

Council Session 04 (COUNCIL-2026-10-18-04): a three-model advisory council's adversarial review of the MHCN-2 draft spec for RWA (real-world-asset) tokenization evidence — verdict 3-0 AMEND before pilot, all amendments adopted same night. Three independent LLM seats (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro) deliberated in isolated, advisory-only, caged environments (no execution, no external access, no governance authority) on the MHCN-2 evidence-lifecycle receipt spec extending the published MHCN-1 hash-anchoring standard. The bundle contains the sealed session prompt, the verbatim votes with deterministic model stamps, the tabulation receipt, and the amended spec (MHCN-2 v0.2).

Amendments sourced from the council (convergent across seats): R6.1 verifiable event-time provenance profile (an anchored digest proves commitment time, not event time — asserted / authenticated-capture / verified-anchor times must be distinct and bound); R7.1 PQC authority-key revocation registry; R9 mandatory legal non-assertion field (LIVE MATCH is a reconciliation verdict, never legal sufficiency); R10 asset_ref namespace registration; R8.1 jurisdictional carve-out disclosure.

Four integrity discrepancies are disclosed in the record, not scrubbed: two enum/verdict-line mismatches; one model self-stamp conflict (self-report "OpenAI ChatGPT" vs deterministic stamp claude_opus_5.5 — the deterministic layer governs); one duplicate vote journaled by one seat (both records retained per the append-only doctrine, the later operative). Advisory-only doctrine throughout: council votes inform the owner and change no governance, thresholds, or playbooks (H-INV-1).

Dual Mesh Benchmark: MEASURED (scoped) — this record documents a three-model advisory deliberation; no neural-mesh inference was involved. Program benchmark: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637 (DeepSeek column: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241). Companion records: MHCN-1 standard DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23445938; full anchor stack DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23446098. Scope caveats: MHCN-2 v0.2 remains a concept spec — no issuer integration exists; no legal-sufficiency claim is made or implied for any regime; anchoring proves existence, not truth. Provenance: append-only ledger entries 0178-0180, github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen.
